name: Norwegian Company Data
author: Skai Digital
description: Remote MCP server over the Norwegian Brønnøysund registers: search companies by industry, municipality, employees, founding date, website and revenue; full profiles with roles and annual accounts; corporate groups; SN2025 industry codes in Norwegian or English; and company websites verified by organisation number, with their platform (Shopify, WooCommerce and others). No API key or account needed. Endpoint: https://tools.skaidigital.com/brreg/mcp

tools.name: search_norwegian_companies
tools.description: Find Norwegian companies in the Brønnøysund register by industry, municipality, legal form, employees, founding or registration date, website pattern and filed accounts, with optional revenue bounds. Returns name, organisation number, industry, employees, address, website, email and phone. Active companies only unless includeInactive is set. Get industry codes from find_norwegian_industry_codes first.

industryCodes.description: SN2025 industry codes from find_norwegian_industry_codes: a section letter (G), division (47), group (47.9) or full code (47.910). Older SN2007 codes match nothing.

municipalities.description: Municipality names (Oslo, Bergen) or four-digit numbers (0301), matched on business or postal address.

postalCodes.description: Four-digit postal codes of the business address.

organizationForms.description: Legal forms such as AS (private limited), ASA (public limited), ENK (sole proprietorship), NUF (foreign branch), DA, ANS, SA or STI.

minEmployees.description: Minimum employees: 0, 1 or 5 and above. The register hides exact counts from 1 to 4.

registeredFrom.description: Earliest registration date; use it to find new companies.

lastFiledAccountsYears.description: Only companies whose latest filed annual accounts are from these years.

includeInactive.description: Include bankrupt companies and companies being wound up. Defaults to false.

minRevenueNok.description: Minimum revenue in NOK in the latest filed accounts; companies filing in another currency do not match. Revenue is not searchable in the register: each page of candidates is fetched, then filtered, so a page can return fewer matches than pageSize. Narrow with employee bounds that fit the revenue range, and continue with nextPage.

maxRevenueNok.description: Maximum revenue in NOK in the latest filed accounts; filtered like minRevenueNok.

pageSize.description: Companies per page, up to 50. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company
tools.description: Full profile of one Norwegian company by organisation number: register details, contact information, activity, CEO, board, auditor and accountant, and the latest filed revenue and profit.

organizationNumber.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_financials
tools.description: Up to three years of filed annual accounts for a Norwegian company: revenue, operating and net profit, payroll, assets, equity, debt and cash, with growth, margin and equity ratio. Set consolidated for group accounts.

organizationNumber.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

consolidated.description: Return the group (konsern) accounts instead of the company accounts; only parent companies file them.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_group
tools.description: The corporate group (konsern) a Norwegian company belongs to: the top parent and every subsidiary with ownership share. Accepts any member of the group.

organizationNumber.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

tools.name: find_norwegian_industry_codes
tools.description: Look up SN2025 industry codes (the Norwegian NACE standard the register uses) by Norwegian or English words or a code prefix. Use the codes in search_norwegian_companies; a broader code such as 62 includes all its subclasses.

tools.name: find_norwegian_company_websites
tools.description: Find the websites of one to five Norwegian companies and the platform each runs on, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. Checks the registered website, the domain of the registered email and domains guessed from the company name, and confirms ownership by finding the organisation number or full company name on the site. For each company returns the website with its source, evidence and confidence (or null); the site platform: shopify_theme, shopify_headless or shopify_headless_likely with the theme, another store platform such as woocommerce, magento, nopcommerce, mystore or 24nettbutikk, a site builder or CMS such as wix, squarespace, webflow, wordpress or custompublish, a headless content platform (sanity, contentful), nextjs for other custom builds, or unknown with the generator tag; and every address checked. Some sites block automated requests and read as unreachable. Takes up to about 15 seconds.

items.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

organizationNumbers.description: One to five organisation numbers, such as one search page split up.
